files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.ChatFeedbackTarget
files.Summary: Identifies an assistant message that can receive user feedback in Chat.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.ChatResponseProtocol
files.Summary: Identifies the wire/text convention emitted by a model. Each non-auto protocol has its own DI profile so control tokens from one model family are never applied to another family's response stream.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilGameActorKind
files.Summary: Identifies the runtime actor that proposed an action.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilGameActorRuntimeDescriptor
files.Summary: Describes one factory-created actor instance and its Council assignment slot.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilGameDirectorContext
files.Summary: Provides the immutable input used by the authoritative GameDirector for one proposed action.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilGameDirectorDecision
files.Summary: Records the GameDirector decision that authorizes or rejects one state transition.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilGameDirectorMode
files.Summary: Chooses how a game action is reviewed before the authoritative session state changes.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilGameSessionRecord
files.Summary: Persistent envelope for an authoritative GameDirector runtime session.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilGameSessionState
files.Summary: Internal authoritative state for one in-chat Council game session. It is deliberately data-only so the session service owns orchestration, rendering and synchronization policy.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilGameSubdirectorPrediction
files.Summary: Represents one bounded prediction from a creature or reactive-object subdirector.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilHardwareRoadPlan
files.Summary: Immutable execution limits selected for one model on one CPU/GPU road.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilMemberReadiness
files.Summary: Readiness facts for one council member and its selected hardware road.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilPreflightReport
files.Summary: Database, function, skill, project and hardware readiness report created before every council run.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilPromptStarterConfiguration
files.Summary: Persistent configuration for one visible chat prompt that can start an AI Council run.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilQuickStart
files.Summary: Describes a direct route into a seeded LocalGPT team and model-preset combination.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilRoleAiSelectionMode
files.Summary: Defines how LocalGPT assigns AI participants to a Council role.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilRoleBoundaryMode
files.Summary: Defines how strictly a Council role must remain inside its assigned responsibility.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilRoleLanguageMode
files.Summary: Defines the language policy applied to a Council role.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilRolePerformanceMode
files.Summary: Defines whether a role behaves as a task specialist or an improvisation player.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilTeamConfiguration
files.Summary: Represents the persisted SQLite row for one Council team configuration.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.CouncilWorkflowStepDefinition
files.Summary: Defines one ordered Council round and its execution, loop, function and ASCII-frame policies.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.DiscoverProjectCompilersRequest
files.Summary: Describes one approval-gated compiler and runtime discovery request.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.DocumentationBuildRecord
files.Summary: Persistent evidence for one documentation build or fallback generation.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.DocumentationUpdatedAttribute
files.Summary: Marks a documented type with the LocalGPT version in which its maintained XML documentation was last reviewed.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.DxAiFunctionCatalogEntry
files.Summary: Database-backed, user-editable policy and discovery record for a DX function or public application service method. Descriptor metadata is refreshed from the running application while user policy fields are preserved.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.EmbeddedFirmwarePlanRecord
files.Summary: Persistent envelope for an embedded firmware plan and its generated artifacts.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.FirstRunOnboardingStatus
files.Summary: Represents the bounded first-run setup state shown by LocalGPT before the user starts normal work.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.HumanCollaborationRequestEditor
files.Summary: Mutable draft state for one human-collaboration response editor. Kept in the business-object domain so Razor components contain behavior and rendering only.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.HumanParticipationMode
files.Summary: Defines how a human participant may join a Council role.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.LocalGptDatabaseOptions
files.Summary: Immutable runtime settings for the local SQLite store.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.LocalGptDocumentationComment
files.Summary: Represents one compiler-generated XML documentation member after localization adaptation and version enrichment.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.LocalGptDocumentationProfile
files.Summary: Describes the documentation routes and availability exposed to local controllers and 1-Wire peers.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.LocalGptDocumentationStatus
files.Summary: Describes the generated LocalGPT documentation artifacts available to the running application.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.LocalGptDocumentationViewerRequest
files.Summary: Describes one safe same-origin documentation view requested by the LocalGPT frontend.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.LocalGptDocumentationViewerState
files.Summary: Represents the scoped in-application documentation viewer state for one Blazor circuit.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.LocalGptHostOptions
files.Summary: Application-host settings. The loopback endpoint remains authoritative while RemoteEndpoint adds optional LAN/VPN access.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.LocalizationCatalogDescriptor
files.Summary: Describes a built-in or user-supplied LocalGPT localization catalog.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.LocalizationCatalogImportResult
files.Summary: Reports the durable result of importing a localization catalog.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.LocalizationCatalogRegistration
files.Summary: Persistent registration for a built-in or user-imported localization JSON catalog.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.LocalizationCatalogValidationResult
files.Summary: Reports the result of validating a user-provided localization JSON catalog.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.OnboardingInstallerProfile
files.Summary: Describes one installer profile that can prepare models or repository knowledge for a LocalGPT workstation.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.OneWireProtocolProfile
files.Summary: Describes the active LocalGPT 1-Wire surface and safe runtime settings for local and linked frontends.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.OneWirePublicSettings
files.Summary: Safe LocalGPT 1-Wire settings shown to users and linked clients.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.OneWireWorkItem
files.Summary: Local runtime state for a protocol work item. Transfer contracts live in LocalGPT.WireProtocolVersion.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.OrganicAddonManifest
files.Summary: Offline, source-controlled description of an organic add-on. The manifest makes an add-on's controller surface discoverable while its process is offline; invocation still requires a live, trusted 1-Wire peer and the existing user-controlled catalog policy.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.OrganicCouncilRoleDefinition
files.Summary: Defines one role and its AI, human, language, runtime-class and pairing policies.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.OrganicCouncilTeamDefinition
files.Summary: Defines one editable LocalGPT Council team, its roles, workflow and architecture contracts.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.ProjectOrganicContext
files.Summary: Stores project and revision metadata used to route organic Council capabilities.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.PromptSuggestion
files.Summary: Describes one reusable Chat prompt and its optional Council-team ownership.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.ProviderModelReference
files.Summary: Provider-qualified model identity. No credential is stored in this object; credentials are resolved from the matching configured provider at execution time.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.RemoteWebEndpointOptions
files.Summary: Optional second Kestrel endpoint for LAN/VPN/browser access. The historical loopback endpoint remains authoritative.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.RuntimeCapabilityDirectorySnapshot
files.Summary: Current dependency-injected function and organic-skill directory persisted for AI context.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.SaveCouncilTeamConfigurationRequest
files.Summary: Carries a reviewed Council team change and its persistence flags.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.SaveFeatureRecordRequest<TRecord>
files.Summary: Approval-gated request for creating or updating one persistent feature record.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.SaveProjectOrganicContextRequest
files.Summary: Extends project organic context with the confirmation required for persistence.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.ServiceOperationBatch
files.Summary: Mutable aggregate for one service-operation diagnostics batch. The object is data only; batching and logging behavior remain owned by the diagnostics proxy.

files.Title: LocalGPT.BusinessObjects.ThemeFusionStep
files.Summary: One successful selection in the order-sensitive Theme Fusion route. The route is intentionally preserved because repeated theme swaps can create a visual result that is not described by the final Base Theme and Style Layer alone.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Components.Layout.ThemeJsChangeDispatcher
files.Summary: Bridges LocalGPT's independently selectable shell and DevExpress component themes to the browser. Browser persistence is owned by the JavaScript module; DevExpress remains the owner of component theme resources.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Controller.CompleteFirstRunOnboardingRequest
files.Summary: Carries the explicit confirmation required to dismiss first-run onboarding.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Controller.DocumentationController
files.Summary: Exposes availability metadata, searchable XML comments and the versioned PDF produced by the DocFX build pipeline.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Controller.DxAiFunctionCatalogController
files.Summary: User-owned catalog for deciding which LocalGPT DX functions and public service methods are visible to AI chat or securely linked 1-Wire peers.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Controller.FeaturePersistenceController
files.Summary: CRUD API for durable records owned by newer LocalGPT feature modules.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Controller.FirstRunOnboardingController
files.Summary: Exposes the bounded first-run setup status and completion operation to LocalGPT frontends.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Controller.ImportLocalizationCatalogRequest
files.Summary: Carries one user localization-catalog import request.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Controller.LocalizationController
files.Summary: Exposes localization catalogs, culture selection and validated user-catalog imports.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Controller.OneWireHttpController
files.Summary: Transport-neutral JSON adapter for small user-built organic clients such as ESP32 firmware. It uses the same envelope, permissions, MFA trust and work spool as the TCP transport.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Diagnostics.ControllerRequestLoggingFilter
files.Summary: Applies structured diagnostics to every MVC controller action without requiring each controller to repeat request lifecycle logging. Client disconnects remain cancellations; unexpected failures are logged and recorded in bounded activity.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Diagnostics.LocalGptCircuitDiagnosticsHandler
files.Summary: Records circuit transitions so a disconnected browser is distinguishable from a blocked UI operation. This handler never performs UI work and therefore cannot delay rendering or disposal.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Diagnostics.ServiceMethodLoggingDispatchProxy
files.Summary: Adds bounded operation diagnostics to LocalGPT interface services without logging arguments, return values, prompts, source, database rows, credentials, or other payload content.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IChatContentRenderer
files.Summary: Converts the progressively accumulated chat response into safe, renderable HTML for the Blazor message template. The renderer is stateless; response buffering remains owned by the per-response formatter.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IChatProtocolProfile
files.Summary: A model-family-specific protocol boundary. Profiles are stateless and selected once per response stream; they must never modify another protocol's content.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.ICouncilGameActorRuntimeFactory
files.Summary: Creates bounded runtime actor instances and maps them to Council role slots.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.ICouncilGameDirectorService
files.Summary: Acts as the authoritative game engine boundary. Controllers and Council actors may propose actions, but only an approved director decision may advance a session.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.ICouncilGameSubdirector
files.Summary: Predicts consequences for one family of runtime actors without owning the authoritative state.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.ICouncilHardwareRoadConfigurationService
files.Summary: Normalizes editable per-model CPU/GPU road settings without coupling the UI to the council scheduler. The returned routes remain transport-compatible 1-Wire business objects.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.ICouncilHardwareRoadPlanner
files.Summary: Resolves a stable, bounded hardware road for every council member. The planner is deliberately separate from the council orchestration so hardware growth does not turn the heartbeat service into another monolith.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.ICouncilTeamConfigurationService
files.Summary: Reads, resolves and user-confirmedly persists database-owned Council team and workflow definitions.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.ICouncilTextPatternDataService
files.Summary: Supplies Council text patterns from the database-backed regex catalog. Runtime text services consume this contract instead of owning regex literals, options, timeouts, or process-wide pattern fields.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IDatabaseFileHealthService
files.Summary: Owns SQLite file validation and conservative recovery before EF Core opens the store.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IDatabaseLoggerReadiness
files.Summary: Keeps database-backed diagnostics dormant until migration and deterministic seeding have completed.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IDatabaseMigrationCompatibilityService
files.Summary: Reconciles verified legacy SQLite schema state with EF migration history before normal migration. It preserves data, creates compatibility backups, and refuses ambiguous partial schemas.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IDocumentationCatalogService
files.Summary: Locates versioned DocFX artifacts and exposes searchable compiler-generated XML comments for the running LocalGPT build.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IDocumentationTranslationAdapter
files.Summary: Adapts maintained XML comment text to the active localization catalog while preserving the original text as fallback.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IDocumentationViewerService
files.Summary: Coordinates accessible in-application documentation viewing for one LocalGPT circuit.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IFeaturePersistenceService
files.Summary: Provides approval-gated CRUD access to persistent records introduced by LocalGPT feature modules.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IFirstRunOnboardingService
files.Summary: Provides the persisted first-run guide, local model discovery summary, installer profiles and council quick starts.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IHumanApprovalExecutionContext
files.Summary: Capability-bearing boundary for execution of one exact persisted approval. It must never be injected into ordinary UI, model tools, or general services.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.ILocalHumanInteractionContext
files.Summary: Capability-bearing boundary for trusted local-human UI interaction only. It can create peer participation context, never operation approval.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.IServiceActivityService
files.Summary: Records bounded, sanitized service-operation state for LocalGPT short-term context. The executor never swallows failures: cancellation and exceptions are recorded and rethrown.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.ISupervisedTaskRunner
files.Summary: Starts intentionally non-blocking work while observing completion, cancellation, and failure. Use this instead of discarding a Task returned by an asynchronous method.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.ISystemVariableDefinitionService
files.Summary: Owns maintained LocalGPT system-variable keys so services never depend on ad-hoc string literals.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Interfaces.SystemVariableDefinition<T>
files.Summary: Describes one strongly typed database-backed system-variable key and its seed default.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.AdaptiveOllamaBenchmarkWiring
files.Summary: Runs a bounded, user-approved benchmark against models already installed in the configured local Ollama runtime. It never pulls models, changes global Ollama state, or overwrites an existing preset.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.ComponentActivityService
files.Summary: Bounded, process-local operational memory for the current LocalGPT run. It records concise UI and service state only; prompts, message bodies, secrets, uploaded content, generated source, parameters, and full exception text are excluded.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Council.CouncilPreflightService
files.Summary: Performs the bounded, lossless database and runtime-directory audit required before every council run. Deterministic seed gaps are filled by database initialization; missing volatile facts are returned as explicit questions instead of being guessed.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Council.CouncilSpoolerService
files.Summary: Process-lifetime Council spooler. Browser circuits can disconnect and later rejoin the same run. A bounded checkpoint file preserves recent run context across application restarts, while active model calls themselves intentionally remain process-owned and cannot be resurrected after a crash.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Council.RuntimeCapabilityDirectoryHostedService
files.Summary: Feeds the runtime directory once per application boot after lossless database initialization.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Council.RuntimeCapabilityDirectoryService
files.Summary: Owns the boot- and run-time DXFunction/organic-skill directory feed. The database copy is discovery metadata only; the DI handler and its declared interaction policy remain authoritative for execution.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Council.Skills.ModelCapabilitySelfAssessmentService
files.Summary: Accepts optional model self-reports as untrusted evidence. Self-reported skills are persisted disabled for automatic authority decisions until the current user approves them in the organic-skill registry.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.CouncilChatClient
files.Summary: Adapts the multi-model Council runtime to the Microsoft.Extensions.AI chat-client contract.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.CouncilDxFunctionOrchestrator
files.Summary: Parses explicit Council DX function call blocks and sends allowed calls through the existing scoped function client. Catalog exposure and invocation metadata remain the source of truth. A failed function call becomes a readable Council step instead of aborting the whole run.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.CouncilGameActorRuntimeFactory
files.Summary: Creates stable per-turn actor descriptors without granting them state-mutation authority.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.CouncilGameDirectorService
files.Summary: Provides deterministic final authority for game controls and coordinates replaceable creature/object subdirectors. A configured low-parameter Council model may review the proposal later, but cannot bypass this service.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.CouncilGameSessionService
files.Summary: Provides one shared control surface for humans and AI players. The deterministic renderer keeps /Chat reactive; a single Council renderer may replace a turn's complete frame through SubmitFrameAsync.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.CouncilRuntimeService
files.Summary: Owns deterministic Council prompt reconstruction, source/artifact generation helpers and shared runtime formatting operations.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.CouncilTeamConfigurationService
files.Summary: Database-owned council team/workflow configuration. System defaults are seeded and merged without overwriting user-edited prompts, roles, capabilities or workflow scripts.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.CreatureCouncilGameSubdirector
files.Summary: Predicts bounded creature reactions for the next authoritative world step.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.DebugArtifactInspectionService
files.Summary: Reads bounded metadata from portable PDB and other debug files without loading or executing them.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.DocumentationCatalogService
files.Summary: Resolves generated DocFX artifacts and compiler-generated XML comments without exposing arbitrary filesystem paths.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.DocumentationTranslationAdapter
files.Summary: Bridges compiler-generated XML comments to the existing LocalGPT localization service without changing that service's contract.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.DocumentationViewerService
files.Summary: Coordinates one focus-managed same-origin documentation modal per Blazor circuit.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.DxAiFunctionCallRecoveryService
files.Summary: Recovers structured DX function calls emitted as assistant text by provider runtimes that do not populate their native tool-call field. Function names are resolved exclusively against the live DI-backed registry; this service never invents or hardcodes callable operations.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.DxAiFunctionCatalogService
files.Summary: Keeps the user-facing DX function catalog in the existing SystemVariables table. This deliberately avoids destructive schema replacement: old databases receive missing records, while user-edited exposure and confirmation settings survive descriptor refreshes and application upgrades.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.DxAiFunctionCatalogSynchronizationGate
files.Summary: Serializes DX function catalog synchronization and policy writes across all scoped catalog-service instances.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.DxAiFunctionHandlerMapService
files.Summary: Builds the scoped DXAI handler directory after the registry has been created. This keeps lazy cycle breaking in the registry while moving validation behavior behind an injected service instead of a static helper.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.DxAiFunctionServiceClient
files.Summary: Scoped control-flow client for DI-backed DXAIFunctions. It deliberately invokes the registry directly instead of making loopback HTTP calls. One scoped client permits one active call, which gives the UI deterministic cancellation and prevents overlapping mutation confirmations.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.FeaturePersistenceService
files.Summary: EF Core implementation for durable feature records that are not transient runtime DTOs.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.FirstRunOnboardingService
files.Summary: Builds LocalGPT's first-run setup guide from database-owned teams and presets plus optional loopback model discovery.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Formatting.ChatContentRenderer
files.Summary: Renders the complete response snapshot supplied by DXAIChat on every stream update. It deliberately does not decode HTML entities: thinking text is encoded by and must stay text.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Formatting.ChatResponseFormatterFactory
files.Summary: Creates stateful response formatters that normalize PlainText, think-tag and Harmony streams into one safe Markdown surface.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Formatting.StructuredTextTranslationService
files.Summary: Converts bounded, syntactically valid JSON blocks into a readable Markdown tree while preserving an encoded raw representation. Candidate detection uses the same canonical regex definitions that are seeded into LocalGPT's database-backed regex catalog; JSON syntax is validated by System.Text.Json.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.GetFirstRunOnboardingStatusFunction
files.Summary: Lets Chat and Council members inspect first-run readiness without changing installer or onboarding state.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.GetTimeAndStateNowFunction
files.Summary: Gives AI chat and Council members an explicit clock and a compact, current runtime-state snapshot. The function is read-only and intentionally returns only the three newest bounded log/council rows.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.HardwareInventoryService
files.Summary: Read-only, cached hardware inventory used for council scheduling. It never changes device state. GPU discovery is best-effort and falls back to explicit user-configured routes when vendor tools are unavailable.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.LearningRoundService
files.Summary: Builds a database-grounded learning-round snapshot and persists model-suggested facts/regexes as untrusted self-maintenance knowledge. It never promotes model output to user-approved authority.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.ListProjectWorkspaceFilesFunction
files.Summary: Lists readable source/text files inside the project currently linked to /chat.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.ListRegexPatternsFunction
files.Summary: Database-backed regular-expression functions used by LocalGPT itself and advertised through the same DI/DX-function/1-Wire discovery path as every other council capability.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Localization.ILocalGptLocalizationService
files.Summary: Reads built-in localization catalogs and persistent user-supplied culture overrides.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Localization.LocalGptLocalizationService
files.Summary: Implements open LocalGPT localization catalogs with English fallback, built-in defaults and persistent user overrides.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.LoggingConfigurationService
files.Summary: Configures the optional LocalGPT logging providers during composition-root startup.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.NavigationUrlService
files.Summary: Preserves the shell sidebar state while creating application-relative navigation URLs.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.NetworkCertificateService
files.Summary: Creates explicit user-requested self-signed PFX certificates for the optional LocalGPT LAN/VPN Kestrel endpoint.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OneWire.InspectPublisherSpreadsheetFunction
files.Summary: Chat-level spreadsheet entry point. It intentionally does not require a Council run: a normal local model can discover this function, ask for the active PublisherStudio session id, and request bounded read-only evidence.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OneWire.InvokeOrganicPluginFunction
files.Summary: Generic escape hatch for explicitly advertised organic capabilities. Dedicated handlers below keep the common spreadsheet workflow discoverable to every normal LocalGPT chat without requiring a Council run.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OneWire.LocalVisionOcrService
files.Summary: Executes bounded local OCR through an Ollama-compatible vision model. The service never accepts file paths; callers must send one current browser-rendered image data URL through the approved 1-Wire request.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OneWire.OneWireRuntimeSecurityService
files.Summary: Owns the runtime-generated LocalGPT 1-Wire identity. Private keys and the MFA seed are created only at runtime, are never compiled into the application, and can be discarded from the frontend to reset every trusted link.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OneWire.ProposePublisherTextFunction
files.Summary: Creates a bounded, reviewable PublisherStudio text proposal from ordinary chat or a Council round. The unique connected PublisherStudio peer is selected automatically when peerId is omitted.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OneWire.ReadOrganicPluginWorkResultFunction
files.Summary: Reads the eventual result of a queued organic operation without reissuing it.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OneWire.RequestPublisherEmbeddedWiringEditorFunction
files.Summary: Requests PublisherStudio's future embedded wiring canvas for a LocalGPT board/pin draft.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OneWire.RequestPublisherReviewedTextFunction
files.Summary: Asks the PublisherStudio user for reviewed text and returns it through the queued work result.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OneWire.RequestPublisherScreenCaptureFunction
files.Summary: Requests one fresh browser-mediated screenshot from PublisherStudio.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OneWire.RequestPublisherScreenRecordFunction
files.Summary: Requests one short browser-mediated screen recording from PublisherStudio.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OneWire.RequestPublisherWebsiteContentFunction
files.Summary: Requests bounded user-approved HTML/DIV/document content from PublisherStudio.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OrganicAddonManifestService
files.Summary: Loads source-controlled organic add-on manifests. Offline manifests are discovery metadata only; they become available for invocation only when the matching trusted 1-Wire peer is connected.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.OrganicCouncilBlueprintSeedDataService
files.Summary: Owns the first-run council-team seed model. Runtime edits remain database-owned by CouncilTeamConfigurationService.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Persistence.CouncilTextPatternDataService
files.Summary: Database boundary for every regular expression used by . Pattern text and flags come from RegexPatterns; the match timeout comes from SystemVariables.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Persistence.DatabaseFileHealthService
files.Summary: Performs bounded SQLite integrity checks and preserves confirmed malformed files before recreation. It deliberately does not treat locks, permission errors, or migration differences as corruption.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Persistence.DatabaseInitializationService
files.Summary: Coordinates database health, compatibility reconciliation, EF migration, and deterministic seeding. Low-level migration-history inspection belongs to .

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Persistence.DatabaseLoggerReadiness
files.Summary: One-way startup gate shared by database initialization and the database logger worker.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Persistence.DatabaseMigrationCompatibilityService
files.Summary: Owns legacy SQLite schema adoption and compatibility backup logic. This responsibility is isolated from database seeding so migration reconciliation is testable, logged, and represented in bounded LocalGPT short-term operational memory.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.Persistence.SystemVariableDefinitionService
files.Summary: Creates the maintained strongly typed system-variable definitions and their deterministic seed values.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.ProviderModelBenchmarkService
files.Summary: Bounded benchmark and council review for provider-qualified models. The service does not download models or alter provider-global settings. Applying a recommendation creates or updates a user-approved LocalGPT model preset whose routes retain provider, endpoint and provider model name.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.ProviderModelRuntimeService
files.Summary: Discovers and opens provider-qualified model sessions. A model name is never treated as a globally unique address: provider kind and endpoint are always retained with it.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.PublicServiceMethodInvoker
files.Summary: Invokes only a public method that the local user explicitly enabled in the database-backed catalog. Parameter binding is typed from the method signature; the caller cannot choose an arbitrary CLR type or method name.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.ReactiveObjectCouncilGameSubdirector
files.Summary: Predicts bounded reactions from doors, switches, pickups and hazards.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.ReadProjectWorkspaceFileFunction
files.Summary: Reads one harmless source/text file from the project linked to /chat.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.RemoteKnowledgeImportService
files.Summary: Downloads a user-selected public GitHub repository or webpage into the same local learn-base style cache used by LocalGPT, lists every returned file, applies a regex file policy, and then delegates database extraction to the existing learn-base importer.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.ServiceMethodDiagnosticsRegistration
files.Summary: Decorates scoped and transient LocalGPT interface services with bounded method-level operational logging. Singleton services remain DI-owned and use their explicit service logging so the decorator can never resolve a scoped dependency from the root provider.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.SupervisedTaskRunner
files.Summary: Observes intentionally concurrent work so exceptions cannot become unobserved Tasks. The runner is process-scoped, but every operation must carry its owning component/service name.

files.Title: LocalGPT.Services.ThemeService
files.Summary: Owns LocalGPT's selectable theme catalog and the two independently selectable theme layers for one Blazor circuit. The shell theme controls LocalGPT page surfaces and Bootstrap metadata; the component theme is applied through DevExpress' supported .
